label: prf:categorical-action-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical action
html: The canonical isomorphism \varphi \colon D_1 \to D_2 is the right adjoint mate of \mathrm{id}_A. Passing a mate through the coevaluation and the evaluation gives (\mathrm{id}_A \otimes \varphi) \circ \mathrm{coev}_1 = \mathrm{coev}_2 and \mathrm{ev}_2 \circ (\varphi \otimes \mathrm{id}_A) = \mathrm{ev}_1. Substitute both into the action computed with D_2. The factors \mathrm{id}_A \otimes \varphi and \Phi \otimes \mathrm{id} commute by the interchange law, and \varphi^{-1} \circ \varphi = \mathrm{id} cancels. What remains is the action computed with D_1.
heading: Proof
